alternatives_considered: Future RFP to alternate RCM vendors
battlecards.why_selected: Agreed to reduce fee to 3.15% of collections (within target range) without triggering $9M early-termination penalty and maintained fully-integrated EHR/PM suite.
battlecards.contract_terms: Existing MSO amended: 3.15% rate retroactive to 9/1/22; agreement locked through Jan-2025 with 4-year price-lock and significant termination fee.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Out-of-market benchmark data, threat to issue competitive RFP 6 months before expiration, and ability to downgrade to Collector only.
supplier_weaknesses: Limited flexibility until faced with competitive pressure
battlecards.switching_costs: ≈$9 M contractual penalty, workflow disruption, data migration and retraining.
complexity_reasons: Termination penalty used as leverage point

battlecards.why_selected: Delivered lowest total landed cost, could service all regions, agreed to 60-day payment terms and provide dedicated implementation resources.
battlecards.contract_terms: Draft enterprise agreement (Aug-2022): 3-year term, price reviews each year, quarterly business reviews, 60-day terms.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Aggregated system-wide volume, head-to-head pricing feedback rounds, promise of sole-source award.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher minimum order size vs some competitors
battlecards.switching_costs: Heartland practices had to move ordering platform and adjust product preferences; moderate staff training effort.
battlecards.notes: No distributor change needed in Mid-Atlantic; Heartland converted from Medline to McKesson October 2022.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Pricing uncompetitive versus McKesson and limited ability to meet enterprise formulary/implementation requirements.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of distributor consolidation and visibility to lower GPO tiers with competitors.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher overall cost, shipping fees, shorter payment terms
battlecards.switching_costs: Product conversions and system set-up for Heartland sites (completed during transition).
battlecards.notes: Removed as primary distributor in Heartland effective 10/31/22.
complexity_reasons: Supplier switched as outcome of RFP

battlecards.why_selected: Offered acceptable 10% price reduction while maintaining existing phlebotomy staff and LIS interfaces, avoiding operational change.
battlecards.contract_terms: Price amendment effective 11/1/22; 2-year term with option to match future market benchmarks.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Quest BAFO showed 19% savings, giving credible switch alternative.
supplier_weaknesses: Past due AR issues highlighted in invoices
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-credentialing physicians, changing courier schedules, EMR interfacing.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Operational leaders preferred to avoid disruption of switching; incremental savings did not outweigh transition burden.
battlecards.contract_terms: Proposed 3-year agreement with 19% savings; not executed.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Used as primary leverage with incumbent to secure concessions.
supplier_weaknesses: Would require staff retraining and new specimen logistics
battlecards.switching_costs: Build new interfaces, negotiate payer-specific routing, renegotiate phlebotomist staffing.
complexity_reasons: Provided benchmark pricing used in negotiations

battlecards.why_not_selected: Pricing above market and pay-per-scan model less cost-effective than perm-hire scenarios.
battlecards.contract_terms: Previous agreements were practice-specific, month-to-month; no renewal executed.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Detailed cost model showing 18-24% savings with alternate scenarios and declining usage volumes.
supplier_weaknesses: Highest cost option, limited ability to scale with Advantia growth plans
battlecards.switching_costs: Need to recruit/hire sonographers and introduce new scheduling processes.
battlecards.notes: Service exit phased through end of 2022 as internal hires ramped.

battlecards.why_selected: Provides flexible recruiting support to supplement 20% of volume; blended solution maximizes long-term savings while mitigating hiring risk.
battlecards.contract_terms: Hourly recruiter model; no fixed term, pay-as-used with volume discounts.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to blend with in-house recruiting and commit only to partial volume.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher per-hour cost than direct hires
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal—engagement can be terminated with 30-day notice.
battlecards.notes: Expected 20% utilization alongside internal hiring; contract recommended by Treya.
complexity_reasons: New supplier added to blended service model
